optional_codes.reason: Occupational exposure to noise: the provider documents thirty years of work around loud machinery with hearing protection only some of the time. Against it, he retired two years ago, so the exposure is not current, and the provider does not connect it to the hearing loss or to the plan. Defensible either way.

unsupported_codes.reason: Noise effects on inner ear, which includes noise-induced hearing loss: reporting a code from this subcategory names noise as the cause of the hearing loss, and the provider states no cause.

citations.H90.3: ICD-10-CM Official Guidelines for Coding and Reporting FY2027, Section I.A.19: the assignment of a diagnosis code is based on the provider's diagnostic statement that the condition exists. Section I.A.15: for conditions not specifically linked by relational terms in the classification, provider documentation must link the conditions in order to code them as related. The Tabular List has an Excludes1 note at H90 for noise-induced hearing loss (H83.3-), so the two are not reported together. Here the physician's diagnosis is sensorineural hearing loss, bilateral; the history records long work around loud machinery and the audiogram shows a notch at 4000 hertz, but the physician states no cause and does not link the hearing loss to noise, so the hearing loss is reported as documented.

coder_notes: The work history and the pattern of the audiogram point to noise, but naming the cause is the provider's call. Tinnitus and dizziness are denied. The examination and the tuning fork tests show no conductive loss. Z77.122, contact with and (suspected) exposure to noise, is not reported: the only noise exposure documented is occupational, and the Excludes2 note at Z77 says that occupational exposure to risk factors is not included there and classifies it to Z57.-. The two codes could be reported together only for two separate exposures, and the note documents one. In practice this documentation would lead to a provider query; the gold is what can be reported from the note as written.
